razonamiento: The architecture shows Anchor's multi-tenant ticketing and booking platform. Customers and tenants access the platform via a CDN (CloudFront). Static web content is served from S3 back to the client. Dynamic requests go through AWS AppSync (GraphQL gateway), which invokes AWS Lambda resolvers or interacts directly with Amazon DynamoDB via pipeline resolvers. Third-party resellers (OTAs) interact via a REST API on Amazon API Gateway through the CDN, routing into Lambda. Lambda writes to and reads from DynamoDB (partitioned by tenant) and queues asynchronous background tasks (such as check-in post-processing or tenant provisioning fan-out) to Amazon SQS, which triggers Lambda for reprocessing.
nombre: Anchor Multi-Tenant Ticketing and Booking Platform
